title: Design effective tool interfaces with clear descriptions and boundaries
scope: summary coverage reviewed against every knowledge/skill; questions are learning exercises, not an exam-readiness certification

knowledge.item: Tool descriptions as the primary mechanism LLMs use for tool selection; minimal descriptions lead to unreliable selection among similar tools
knowledge.evidence: EXAM11/API15: description là tín hiệu chọn tool, mô tả mơ hồ gây misroute.

knowledge.item: The importance of including input formats, example queries, edge cases, and boundary explanations in tool descriptions
knowledge.evidence: EXAM11: formats, query examples, edge cases và ranh giới.

knowledge.item: How ambiguous or overlapping tool descriptions cause misrouting (e.g., analyze_content vs analyze_document with near-identical descriptions)
knowledge.evidence: EXAM11: analyze_content/analyze_document có phạm vi trùng.

knowledge.item: The impact of system prompt wording on tool selection: keyword-sensitive instructions can create unintended tool associations
knowledge.evidence: EXAM11: quy tắc system prompt gắn keyword với tool có thể lấn description.

skills.item: Writing tool descriptions that clearly differentiate each tool's purpose, expected inputs, outputs, and when to use it versus similar alternatives
skills.evidence: API15/EXAM11: nêu purpose/inputs/outputs và khi dùng so với tool khác.

skills.item: Renaming tools and updating descriptions to eliminate functional overlap (e.g., renaming analyze_content to extract_web_results with a web-speci fi c description)
skills.evidence: EXAM11: rename extract_web_results và mô tả web-specific.

skills.item: Splitting generic tools into purpose-speci fi c tools with de fi ned input/output contracts (e.g., splitting a generic analyze_document into extract_data_points, summarize_content, and verify_claim_against_source)
skills.evidence: EXAM11: tách extract_data_points/summarize_content/verify_claim_against_source.

skills.item: Reviewing system prompts for keyword-sensitive instructions that might override well-written tool descriptions
skills.evidence: EXAM11: rà cả system instruction có quy tắc keyword sai.

title: Implement structured error responses for MCP tools
scope: summary coverage reviewed against every knowledge/skill; questions are learning exercises, not an exam-readiness certification

knowledge.item: The MCP isError fl ag pattern for communicating tool failures back to the agent
knowledge.evidence: EXAM11: MCP isError khác API is_error.

knowledge.item: The distinction between transient errors (timeouts, service unavailability), validation errors (invalid input), business errors (policy violations), and permission errors
knowledge.evidence: EXAM11: transient/validation/business/permission và cách phục hồi khác nhau.

knowledge.item: Why uniform error responses (generic "Operation failed") prevent the agent from making appropriate recovery decisions
knowledge.evidence: EXAM11/15: Operation failed chung làm mất tín hiệu.

knowledge.item: The difference between retryable and non-retryable errors, and how returning structured metadata prevents wasted retry attempts
knowledge.evidence: EXAM11: retryability metadata tránh retry vô ích.

skills.item: Returning structured error metadata including errorCategory (transient/validation/permission), isRetryable boolean, and human-readable descriptions
skills.evidence: EXAM11: payload errorCategory/isRetryable/description theo contract ứng dụng.

skills.item: Including retriable: false fl ags and customer-friendly explanations for business rule violations so the agent can communicate appropriately
skills.evidence: EXAM11/Q1: business retriable=false, lý do dễ hiểu và đường xử lý phù hợp.

skills.item: Implementing local error recovery within subagents for transient failures, propagating to the coordinator only errors that cannot be resolved locally along with partial results and what was attempted
skills.evidence: EXAM11: subagent phục hồi cục bộ giới hạn rồi gửi lỗi còn lại/partial results/attempts.

skills.item: Distinguishing between access failures (needing retry decisions) and valid empty results (representing successful queries with no matches)
skills.evidence: EXAM11/15: successful empty khác access failure.

title: Distribute tools appropriately across agents and con fi gure tool choice
scope: summary coverage reviewed against every knowledge/skill; questions are learning exercises, not an exam-readiness certification

knowledge.item: The principle that giving an agent access to too many tools (e.g., 18 instead of 4-5) degrades tool selection reliability by increasing decision complexity
knowledge.evidence: EXAM11: tool nhiều ngoài vai trò tăng decision complexity, số18/4–5 là ví dụ.

knowledge.item: Why agents with tools outside their specialization tend to misuse them (e.g., a synthesis agent attempting web searches)
knowledge.evidence: EXAM11: synthesis không nên nhận toàn bộ search/edit tools.

knowledge.item: Scoped tool access: giving agents only the tools needed for their role, with limited cross-role tools for speci fi c high-frequency needs
knowledge.evidence: EXAM11/Q2: scope theo vai trò, verify_fact hẹp cho nhu cầu thường xuyên.

knowledge.item: tool_choice con fi guration options: "auto", "any", and forced tool selection ({"type": "tool", "name": "..."})
knowledge.evidence: EXAM11/05: auto/any/forced-name khác nhau.

skills.item: Restricting each subagent's tool set to those relevant to its role, preventing cross-specialization misuse
skills.evidence: EXAM11: giới hạn tools theo specialization.

skills.item: Replacing generic tools with constrained alternatives (e.g., replacing fetch_url with load_document that validates document URLs)
skills.evidence: EXAM11: thay fetch_url bằng load_document có URL validation thật.

skills.item: Providing scoped cross-role tools for high-frequency needs (e.g., a verify_fact tool for the synthesis agent) while routing complex cases through the coordinator
skills.evidence: EXAM11/Q2: verify_fact hẹp, việc phức tạp qua coordinator.

skills.item: Using tool_choice forced selection to ensure a speci fi c tool is called fi rst (e.g., forcing extract_metadata before enrichment tools), then processing subsequent steps in follow-up turns
skills.evidence: EXAM11/15Q1: force metadata rồi thực thi/validate/result, follow-up mở enrichment.

skills.item: Setting tool_choice: "any" to guarantee the model calls a tool rather than returning conversational text
skills.evidence: EXAM05/11: any buộc tool trong tập, không buộc tên.

title: Integrate MCP servers into Claude Code and agent work fl ows
scope: summary coverage reviewed against every knowledge/skill; questions are learning exercises, not an exam-readiness certification

knowledge.item: MCP server scoping: project-level (.mcp.json) for shared team tooling vs user-level (~/.claude.json) for personal/experimental servers
knowledge.evidence: EXAM09: project .mcp.json và user ~/.claude.json.

knowledge.item: Environment variable expansion in .mcp.json (e.g., ${GITHUB_TOKEN}) for credential management without committing secrets
knowledge.evidence: EXAM09: ${GITHUB_TOKEN}, không commit literal secret.

knowledge.item: That tools from all con fi gured MCP servers are discovered at connection time and available simultaneously to the agent
knowledge.evidence: EXAM09: discovery khi kết nối, nhiều server đồng thời không tự loại trừ.

knowledge.item: MCP resources as a mechanism for exposing content catalogs (e.g., issue summaries, documentation hierarchies, database schemas) to reduce exploratory tool calls
knowledge.evidence: EXAM09: issue summaries/docs hierarchy/database schemas như catalogs.

skills.item: Con fi guring shared MCP servers in project-scoped .mcp.json with environment variable expansion for authentication tokens
skills.evidence: EXAM09/Q1: project shared config, mỗi thành viên cấp env/auth riêng.

skills.item: Con fi guring personal/experimental MCP servers in user-scoped ~/.claude.json
skills.evidence: EXAM09: personal experimental server ở user scope.

skills.item: Enhancing MCP tool descriptions to explain capabilities and outputs in detail, preventing the agent from preferring built-in tools (like Grep) over more capable MCP tools
skills.evidence: EXAM09: mô tả năng lực/output MCP rõ khi mạnh hơn Grep.

skills.item: Choosing existing community MCP servers over custom implementations for standard integrations (e.g., Jira), reserving custom servers for team-speci fi c work fl ows
skills.evidence: EXAM09: đánh giá server Jira/community cho tích hợp chuẩn, custom cho việc riêng.

skills.item: Exposing content catalogs as MCP resources to give agents visibility into available data without requiring exploratory tool calls
skills.evidence: EXAM09/API26: resource catalog hỗ trợ visibility không thử hàng loạt tool queries.

title: Select and apply built-in tools (Read, Write, Edit, Bash, Grep, Glob) effectively
scope: summary coverage reviewed against every knowledge/skill; questions are learning exercises, not an exam-readiness certification

knowledge.item: Grep for content search (searching fi le contents for patterns like function names, error messages, or import statements)
knowledge.evidence: EXAM09: Grep tìm nội dung function/error/import.

knowledge.item: Glob for fi le path pattern matching ( fi nding fi les by name or extension patterns)
knowledge.evidence: EXAM09: Glob tìm path theo pattern.

knowledge.item: Read/Write for full fi le operations; Edit for targeted modi fi cations using unique text matching
knowledge.evidence: EXAM09: Read/Write full-file, Edit targeted anchor duy nhất.

knowledge.item: When Edit fails due to non-unique text matches, using Read + Write as a fallback for reliable fi le modi fi cations
knowledge.evidence: EXAM09/Q3: fallback Read/Write kiểm soát khi anchor không duy nhất.

skills.item: Selecting Grep for searching code content across a codebase (e.g., fi nding all callers of a function, locating error messages)
skills.evidence: EXAM09/Q2: Grep tìm function callers/nội dung.

skills.item: Selecting Glob for fi nding fi les matching naming patterns (e.g., **/*.test.tsx)
skills.evidence: EXAM09/Q2: Glob **/*.test.tsx.

skills.item: Using Read to load full fi le contents followed by Write when Edit cannot fi nd unique anchor text
skills.evidence: EXAM09/Q3: đọc đầy đủ rồi Write và kiểm tra diff.

skills.item: Building codebase understanding incrementally: starting with Grep to fi nd entry points, then using Read to follow imports and trace fl ows, rather than reading all fi les upfront
skills.evidence: EXAM09: Grep entrypoints, Read imports/theo flow, không nạp tất cả trước.

skills.item: Tracing function usage across wrapper modules by fi rst identifying all exported names, then searching for each name across the codebase
skills.evidence: EXAM09/15Q3: xác định exports/aliases wrapper, tìm từng tên.
